investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint file downloads (2100 files) was observed for Kevin.Smit@globalcorp.ee, exceeding the 24-hour baseline of 40 files. The activity originated from 109.70.100.1 to 40.108.201.15 on endpoint CLOUD-AUTOMATE-NODE, using Python-urllib/3.12, which suggests automated retrieval rather than typical human-driven access. Sample files include PROD_SQL_DUMP_JAN_2026.bak, Customer_Encryption_Keys.txt, and Global_Sales_Database_Export.sql, indicating exposure of high-value data. Local time for Vienna was around 00:59 on 2026-02-01, i.e., outside normal working hours, which adds risk; given the volume and automated access, this activity warrants High Priority escalation.
